text: Could you make a promo for our Lantern Night? I’m excited about the event and a little worried that the promo won’t get across how lovely it feels in person. What I’m after is an 8-second video in a vertical format. It should show glowing lanterns after dark. Please put the date and venue big on screen so people know when and where to come. I don’t want any voiceover.
